'''Fin Mak'lath''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] from [[Kalarcha]],<ref name="SWI" /> the capital city of [[Athallia]]. There, he served as a police officer until his [[Fin Mak'lath's wife|wife]] was killed in food riots. After his wife's death, Mak'lath moved to [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] and joined the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]]. Mak'lath was present with [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], [[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]], and fellow Wing Guardsmen just prior to the [[Occupation of Bespin]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].
